messages:
sam: Morning — quick procurement + PR check. CloudVendorX confirmed racks shipping next week (ETA next Fri). Can we reserve ~32 A100s into a new Dedicated pool? Also PR #4526 (terraform) is ready but needs an LGTM before I merge. Any blockers on capacity or billing?

leila: cc @marco @tara — I skimmed the PR, looks straightforward (mostly vars). Happy to LGTM but want confirmation on vendor ETA and billing hold first. :eyes:

marco: Vendor emailed this morning: tentative arrival 2024-04-11 -> racks staged 04/11–04/12. We currently show ~12 unallocated A100 slots in us-west across soft-pools. Reserving 32 will shrink demo capacity. If we do incremental attach that's safer.

tara: can we land infra changes early and attach incrementally? e.g. apply for 8 then scale to 32 as racks arrive?

sam: yep incremental attach works. terraform var pattern: set initial_racks then scale. quick snippet: 
```
module "dedicated_pool" {
  source = "redwood/dedicated"
  initial_racks = 2
  provision = var.provision
  reserved = true
}
```
set `provision = false` to avoid billing until finance clears.

leila: note: procurement put invoice on hold pending PO review. finance needs final thumbs up before we flip provision. pinging @marco for approval status. :money_with_wings:

marco: approving PO today. Payment terms mean provisioning triggers ~48h after invoice clears, fwiw. I'll leave a note in the PR with "finance ok" when done.

oncall-bot: Deploy bot: PR #4526 passed CI (unit, plan). Smoke test window reserved: 2024-04-11 19:00 UTC (04/11 12:00 PDT). :white_check_mark:

tara: suggestion — land PR now with `provision = false` so infra config exists, then we flip to true after invoice clears and first rack online. avoids big merge later.

leila: Agreed. I'll approve and merge once marco adds finance confirmation comment. I'll default provision=false in the merged branch and add a follow-up task to flip.

sam: tiny heads-up: does creating the pool with provision=false affect quota dashboards or demo availability?

leila: it creates the config but won't allocate GPUs or count against quota while provision=false. So demos unaffected until we flip.

sam: perfect. Action list:
- marcos: approve PO + add "finance ok" comment in PR (marco)
- leila: merge PR with `provision=false` and tag follow-up
- tara: run smoke test when vendor confirms first rack live
- sam: follow up on remaining A100 pool numbers and post here

marco: finance ok — left comment in PR and approved. go ahead and merge. :white_check_mark:

leila: merging now, will default `provision=false`. tagging rollout task (#infra-ops).

sam: thanks all — vendor updated: first 2 racks inbound 2024-04-11 10:00 PDT. Tara, smoke test scheduled 12:00 PDT. I will post the test logs here after. :rocket:

tara: noted, will run smoke and report. If anything looks off I'll escalate in this thread. :mag: 

leila: merged and added follow-up ticket. Nice and tidy. :tada:
